description: The system shall store playlogs from players.
Each playlog must contain a date, client, and assigned player.
The system shall store player connections.
Each connection must contain a date, client, and assigned player.
The connection status can only be 'connected' or 'not connected'.
The system shall store platform actions (audit trail).
Each action must contain a date, client, user, and assigned player.
All actions must be performed on a platform entity.
The system shall allow authorized users to list playlogs.
Playlogs visible to the user shall depend on their assigned permissions.
The system shall allow authorized users to list player connections.
Connections visible to the user shall depend on their assigned permissions.
The system shall allow authorized users to list platform actions.
Actions visible to the user shall depend on their assigned permissions.
The system shall respond to any user action within 5 seconds.
The system shall be available at all times, except for scheduled updates.
The system shall support an unlimited number of concurrent connections.
The platform scales dynamically with changes in simultaneous connections.
The system shall scale in capacity as data volume increases.
The system scales automatically as data increases.
System functionalities shall only be accessible to users with appropriate permissions.
Users without permission cannot access data for which they do not have authorization.
Confidential user information must be protected to ensure privacy.
Users can only observe confidential data belonging to their own user account.
